eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Madera; Mariposa; Merced, CA; at 10:31 PM on SEP 15, 2026 Effective until 12:31 AM SEP 16, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
AN AMBER ALERT IS BEING ISSUED BY THE CHP ON BEHALF OF THE MERCED POLICE DEPARTMENT.

ON SEPTEMBER 15, 2026, AT 8:41 PM, SHAILA IBARRA AND ALESSANDRA MONDRAGON WERE ABDUCTED FROM MERCED, CALIFORNIA. SHAILA IBARRA IS A 11 YEAR OLD HISPANIC FEMALE, 5 FEET, WEIGHING 115 POUNDS, WITH BROWN HAIR AND BROWN EYES. IBARRA IS WEARING BLUE PAJAMA PANTS AND A BLUE T-SHIRT.

ALESSANDRA MONDRAGON IS A 9 YEAR OLD HISPANIC FEMALE, 4 FEET 3 INCHES, WEIGHING 95 POUNDS, WITH BROWN HAIR AND BROWN EYES. MONDRAGON IS WEARING A MAROON T-SHIRT AND BLUE AND WHITE VERTICLE STRIPED SHORTS.

THE SUSPECT, MARIO IBARRA-GUZMAN, IS A 34 YEAR OLD HISPANIC MALE, STANDING 5 FEET 7 INCHES TALL, WEIGHING 170 POUNDS WITH BROWN HAIR AND BROWN EYES. IBARRA-GUZMAN IS WEARING A PEACH SHIRT, BLACK SHORTS, AND FLIP FLOPS.

THE SUSPECT WAS LAST SEEN DRIVING A WHITE 2013 TOYOTA VENZA, LICENSE PLATE 9 M P D 9 1 5.
